### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/platform-objects`, touching **291** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/index.ts`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**67** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json f4b1f9ee0865544d0a404a2ceb0b02b4d77cb69c`.

⛔ **19** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/index.ts`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **2** anchor(s) matched too much of the corpus to be a work list: `sys_user (symbol, 49 pages)`, `snake_case (literal, 52 pages)`
- **33** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **64** of **227** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **163** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **163**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **104** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **3** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json f4b1f9ee0865544d0a404a2ceb0b02b4d77cb69c` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `fc504a9f74d67f488aba372763c3adf83bc53e68` — the merge of head `ee1cc775c0a02d21de179bb380f102f507744be3` into base `f4b1f9ee0865544d0a404a2ceb0b02b4d77cb69c`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin fc504a9f74d67f488aba372763c3adf83bc53e68 && git checkout fc504a9f74d67f488aba372763c3adf83bc53e68
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin f4b1f9ee0865544d0a404a2ceb0b02b4d77cb69c ee1cc775c0a02d21de179bb380f102f507744be3 && git checkout -B drift-repro f4b1f9ee0865544d0a404a2ceb0b02b4d77cb69c && git merge --no-ff ee1cc775c0a02d21de179bb380f102f507744be3

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json f4b1f9ee0865544d0a404a2ceb0b02b4d77cb69c
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs f4b1f9ee0865544d0a404a2ceb0b02b4d77cb69c` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review — ACCEPT

Head-sha: `ee1cc775c0a02d21de179bb380f102f507744be3`

**席位意见：ACCEPT · 默认档，席位自审 · 2026-11-08T13:39Z**。本 PR 不碰任何契约面：`Clause-②: no`、`Metadata-protocol: none`，没有 `packages/spec/src`，也没有 governed 文本。按 fr（#31233）、pt-BR（#31440）、ru（#31466，ACCEPT 6720497415）的先例，由席位在默认档自审。PR 有 7442 行，超过 3000 行门槛，按 Tier H 走人工合并。

## 席位核对

- **形态：** draft，目标 `main`。首行 `Part of #30512`，ko 还没做，全文没有任何闭合关键词。正文带 `Thread-read: 6720709854`（de 的认领评论）。
- **覆盖：** 36 个文件，与 #31466 逐文件对齐，包括：
  - de 的两份生成包和出处表，手写 `de.ts` 与它的摘要表；
  - 抽取配置、注册行；
  - 三处内嵌映射：`sys-user.page.ts` 36 处、`sys-organization.page.ts` 6 处、`system.datasets.ts` 的空值标签；
  - ru 加过的各测试语言列表。

  已有语言一个字节都没变。席位读了 `sys-user.page.ts` 的 diff：每行只是在 `ru` 后面追加一个 `de`。
- **抽读译文：** 席位按间隔读了 `de.ts` 和内嵌映射：`KI-Assistenten verbinden`、`Cloud-Verbindung`、`Warteschlangenmitglieder`、`Zugriffsrichtlinie`、`Benutzererlebnis`、`Anmeldeereignisse`、`Kontostatus`、`Identität`、`Positionen`、`E-Mail nicht bestätigt`。卡上要求钉住的措辞都在：`Meine ausstehenden Genehmigungen`、`Zuweisungsregeln`、`Alle Einstellungen`、`KI-Assistent`。与 `en` 字节相同的叶子有 155 处，比 ru 的 45 处多，因为德语本来就和英语共用很多词，比如 `Details`、`Audit`、`System`、`Status`。正文按类别逐条列出了这些叶子。
- **repeater-row-properties：** 9 处与 `Name` 重复的叶子被拒绝后，dev 改成带父级的名称（如 `Parametername`、`Indexname`），没有绕开这个检查。
- **门禁（check-runs @ `ee1cc775`）：** 35 个 success，13 个 skipped，0 个失败。dev 在 `e16f19cc` 跑了本地 68 个门，全部退出码 0；scoped eslint 退出码 0。之后合了两次 `origin/main`：
  - #31475 的审计动作标签在 plugin-audit 自己的包里，platform-objects 重新抽取后没有 diff。
  - #31448 新增 3 个 `sys_sso_provider` 叶子，6 条 de 文字已在 `ee1cc775` 补译，重新抽取后 `check-i18n-bundles` 同步。platform-objects 1886 个测试全部通过，typecheck 干净。
- **changeset：** `30512-platform-objects-de.md`，给 `@objectstack/platform-objects` 记一个 patch。
- **接受的偏差：** plugin-audit 的 de 标签仍是英文回退。它不在认领的文件面里，和 ru 一样。
- **落地条款：** `check-governed-merges --pr 31511`：36 个路径中 0 个命中 governed，+7394/−48，超过 3000 行，属于 Tier H。需要 GOVERNED_APPROVERS（os-zhuang 或 hotlong）批准后才能进队。批准后，席位让卡线程再合一次 `origin/main` 并重跑 i18n 同步门，然后由席位落地。
